name: 21123-multiimage-qwen3vl8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, bf16, no quantization_config. ~17 GB of weights.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1, bounded at 128 requests with a 1200 s safety cap; 10% warmup and 10% cooldown both pinned to `mode: requests`, so 102 requests are measured.
workload: guidellm, ONE turn: TEN 1280x720 JPEGs, every one of them distinct, plus 512 tokens of text in and 256 tokens out, lengths fixed, `ignore_eos` at temperature 0.0.
purpose: A vision assistant answering ten-photo questions with short replies, one user at a time, on a single GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: sglang at commit 588320262ee82ac32d54647e81f2184c2b6254dd. A commit and not a release,
# so the interpreter is named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`.
# The launch line is bare: every flag not named here is left at this commit's default.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
random-seed: 42
